reason: Conversation 1 broke down entirely: it repeated the identical two questions three times after the homeowner had already answered them, ignored the explicit 'that's the same two questions' complaint, and its headings asserted unsupported diagnoses ('defrost system failure', 'failed heater or thermostat') while giving no next step or landlord escalation. Conversation 2 was imperfect - it assumed a fan frost-free design, over-focused on the drain hole, and its closing line overstated certainty about a 'failed defrost component' - but it stayed within the safety boundary, proposed the correct low-cost test (switch off and full defrost), offered non-invasive alternatives when the user resisted emptying the freezer, and appropriately escalated to the letting agent for an engineer. Neither asked for the model number, but 2 actually progressed the homeowner towards the right outcome while 1 provided nothing beyond the first turn.
